cf6395dc9a05: Choose a checking tool · translationCore 4 Help
5aab95d571be: Each checking tool takes you through the whole book once, one item at a time. translationCore remembers your place in each tool.
edfdb403ebaa: Open a book, then click Check at the top.
e1de982504aa: Look at the cards. Each one shows how many items are resolved and which one is next.
f0d077c72286: Click Start checking → on the card you want, or Continue → if you have started. On Community Checking the link is Open →.
7843b655da84: To come back to this list, click ← All checking tools at the top left of the tool.
d78a20319fa6: The next time you click Check, translationCore opens the checking tool you used last.
edf95aa147b6: Translation Words: key terms, one at a time.
a159c17f8077: Translation Notes: the places a translation note points to.
8bfdd2ed6811: Align: link your words to the original language. This card counts drafted verses, so a book with nothing drafted says No items in this book yet.
7def275b185b: Community Checking: read the whole book as a printed page and export it for reviewers.
fa2c72678197: A story project has no Align card.
d228c7b705aa: If a card says Needs downloading or Unavailable offline, click Fix this…. See Fix a missing resource. The other tools still work while you fix it.
b756c9f3a838: Note: Only drafted verses can be checked. Draft first, then come back.
